text:
dana: Quick thread — I want to lock the pilot gating and acceptance criteria for the Optimize toolkit (batching, prefix/KV caching, quant recommendations, eval-triggered alerts). Goal: clear go/no-go checklist we can show to pilots.

michael: 👍 can we scope into two buckets: (1) perf & cost SLOs, (2) quality/regression SLOs. Pilot should trigger alerts when either violates thresholds for N requests.

priya: Agree. For perf/cost we should define per-model baseline qps, p95 latency target, and token cost delta threshold. Example: p95 <= 150ms, cost drop >= 18% vs baseline.

evan: For quality, we need eval-triggered alerts tied to a small prompt set. If average pass-rate drops > 3% or top-1 BLEU drops > X for 1h -> page oncall.

michael: Also propose an adaptive priority matrix so system recommends which knob to try first (batching vs cache vs quant) based on workload signal. We'll need simple heuristics.

priya: sketch of matrix idea:
- High tail latency, low token ratio -> prefer batching
- Repeated prefixes across requests -> enable prefix/KV cache
- Stable outputs, heavy token spend -> recommend 4-bit quant + eval check

michael: exactly. We should publish the heuristics and a small CLI to preview recommendations.

dana: For pilot gating: must have
- instrumented eval harness with 100 seed prompts and auto-alerts
- baseline perf/cost numbers captured for 72h pre-change
- rollback path + canary routing

evan: Ops asks: canary traffic min 5% for 30m, automated revert on p95 regression >20%. Also we need a manual override in console.

priya: customer acceptance criteria (pilot):
1) observable cost improvement >= 10% on their workload or no regression in quality
2) p95 latency within agreed SLA (±10% of baseline)
3) no false-positive eval-alerts > 2/day

michael: implementation notes — recommend the toolkit emits these signals to existing observability:
- metric: optimize.recommendation.applied (labels: model, knob, quant-level)
- metric: optimize.eval.alerts (labels: check, severity)

priya: sample config we can show pilots: 
```yaml
optimize:
  knobs:
    batching: auto
    prefix_cache: on
    quantization: {enabled: true, level: 4}
  eval_alerts:
    dataset: pilot_seeds_v1
    pass_rate_threshold: -0.03 # 3% drop
    resolution: 5m
  canary:
    pct: 5
    duration: 30m
```

dana: Nice. We also need launch gates doc entries: legal/privacy signoff, KMS integration for private pilots, and runbook for FAQ/rollback.

evan: Does the team want to surface a "confidence" score with each recommendation? e.g., high/medium/low based on sample size.

michael: yes — confidence can be function of sample volume and prefix repeat ratio. Low confidence -> show estimated uplift range.

priya: UX note: in the console we should show a one-click apply with preview modal showing expected cost delta and risk tags.

dana: timeline proposal:
- Week 0: finalize heuristics + eval harness
- Week 1–2: instrument metrics + small CLI preview
- Week 3: internal canary + runbook dry-run
- Week 4: invite 2 pilot customers

michael: resource ask: need 2 engs for 3 weeks to wire metrics + canary automation, 1 PM to run pilots.

evan: ops request: add a safeguard: if quantization applied and eval pass-rate drop > 1.5% within 1h, auto-revert. Keep that configurable.

priya: on rollout we should tier quant recommendations: suggest light quant (8-bit) first, then 4-bit with forced eval check.

dana: final items for the gating checklist I want in the PR:
- benchmark notebook + reproducible script
- canary config (pct/duration/revert criteria)
- eval dataset + owner
- docs: how to read recommendation confidence

michael: I'll draft the PR template and add the metrics names. will tag you all.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy scheduled: optimize-toolkit/canary v0.9 -> 5% traffic in 15m (Triggered by michael) :rocket:

priya: :thumbsup: thanks — I'll draft the pilot acceptance matrix and drop in the pilot folder.

dana: Great — if no objections i'll finalize the gating doc and PR template today. Otherwise flag issues now. :eyes:
